description: May I lawfully fetch this URL? Fetches robots.txt and returns an allow/disallow verdict for the given URL and user-agent, with the matched rule, crawl-delay and sitemaps. Only /robots.txt is read; no page content is fetched. Price: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base (eip155:8453), paid with x402 in params._meta["x402/payment"]. HTTP: GET https://api.firstmention.uk/s/websearch/crawlcheck
name: websearch__crawlcheck
